description:
emit_runtime_type_test (runtime_test.rs) already answers a test on an unboxed lane with a constant. It returns a three-way answer (always, never, a flag), and the two walkers (lower_dispatch_test in native.rs; emit_guard_dispatch_node in receive.rs) emit only the live successor. Then as_raw_i64, as_raw_f64, receive_value_int and receive_value_float refuse a wrong lane instead of coercing to zero.

Fails before, passes after: with those four returning an error, 184 of the 296 mixed-lane guard programs (gh-303-spikes/matrix.py) fail to compile; after, none do and all 296 match Elixir on three paths. The 296 run as one generated matrix test, not 296 numbered fixtures.

Removed: the zero-value wrong-lane coercion.

Acceptance: full gate green; no pin rises.
title: A test the lane decides emits only its live edge
